notes.title: Controller/Steering Wheel Setup
notes.content:
How to setup a controller or steering wheel:

1. Launch the game .exe
2. Go to Input tab
3. Search for "SteeringWheel..." axes
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28000722/0dc96898ee130c4a2d16f199cf5ad5d0fb4a61b1.png[/img]
4. Modify it
5. Press Play!
6. In the Main Menu select target control mode!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28000722/1f9be41d48350d61765a6cc459c503d02e80f866.png[/img]
Done!
